audience.programmeDescription: VU Computer Science combines programming and software engineering with algorithms, formal reasoning, mathematics, computer systems, networks, data and AI. Its general bachelor includes constrained second-year options, an open academic semester and a supervised scientific CS project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: Both UCR options teach programming, algorithms, computer systems, mathematics and machine learning. The first adds more software development and advanced algorithms. The second adds linear systems, advanced calculus and robotic motion planning.

curriculum.limitation: This 180 EC example includes three restricted second-year choices and 30 EC of open study in year three. Students need 120 EC from the Computer Science bachelor before starting the 15 EC project. They can work individually or in a group. Two examiners assess each student’s technical contribution, thesis and presentation.

componentNotes.y2-09: Selected writing option, 3 EC in period 3.
componentNotes.y2-10: Selected interaction design option, 6 EC in period 6.
componentNotes.y2-11: Selected security option, 6 EC in period 5.
componentNotes.y3-01: Open study can include a minor, an approved elective package or study abroad.
componentNotes.y3-03: A supervised scientific computing project assessed individually.

BENENTR111.text: You will learn how to function in a ‘real-world’ design and development team for consumer products. We go through the phases of design and development: probe customer needs, translate these into a product concept, develop a fabrication method, analyze sustainability, analyze costs and proceeds. Design and development involves interviewing customers, brainstorming, laboratory experiments, quantitative modeling, constructing a prototype, and considering protection of intellectual property.
